name: Spam Assist
description: Detects when you start spamming and takes over with an even, alternate spam. Rewrite with iOS support.

mode.name: Spam Speed Mode
mode.description: Match: copies your detected speed (smoothed). Fixed: always uses the Fixed CPS setting.

fixed-cps.name: Fixed CPS
fixed-cps.description: Spam speed used in Fixed mode.

max-cps.name: Max CPS Cap
max-cps.description: The assist never clicks faster than this.

duty-cycle.name: Hold Percentage
duty-cycle.description: How much of each click cycle the button is held down (50 = equal press and release).

alternate-players.name: Alternate Players (Dual)
alternate-players.description: In dual mode, each auto click goes to Player 1 then Player 2 alternately instead of both at once.

show-indicator.name: Show Indicator
show-indicator.description: Shows a small label in the top left while the assist is active.

cps-threshold.name: Activation CPS
cps-threshold.description: The assist kicks in once your real clicking speed reaches this many clicks per second.

min-clicks.name: Min Clicks To Detect
min-clicks.description: How many clicks inside the detection window are needed before the CPS is trusted.

window-ms.name: Detection Window (ms)
window-ms.description: How far back clicks are counted when measuring CPS.

smart-detect.name: Smart Detect
smart-detect.description: Only activates when your clicks look like real rhythmic spam (even timing, not slowing down).

consistency.name: Smart Detect Tolerance
consistency.description: Max timing variation allowed between clicks (0.05 = very strict, 1.0 = very loose).

hold-release-ms.name: Hold Override (ms)
hold-release-ms.description: If you hold the button longer than this, the assist hands control back to you immediately.

idle-timeout-ms.name: Stop When Idle (ms)
idle-timeout-ms.description: The assist stops this long after your last real input.

wave-direction.name: Wave Spam Direction
wave-direction.description: Match Me: copies whether your zigzag climbs, falls or runs straight. Straight / Up / Down: always use that direction.

wave-steepness.name: Wave Up/Down Steepness (%)
wave-steepness.description: Hold percentage used when the direction is Up (Down uses the opposite). Higher = steeper.

wave-deadzone.name: Straight Dead Zone (%)
wave-deadzone.description: In Match Me mode, a zigzag within this many percent of even counts as straight.

ship-straight.name: Ship Straight Flight
ship-straight.description: In ship, the hold length is adjusted so the ship stays at the height where the assist started.

ship-correction.name: Ship Correction Strength
ship-correction.description: How hard the ship is steered back to its locked height. Raise it if it drifts, lower it if it wobbles.

humanize.name: Humanization
humanize.description: Adds natural variation to the spam.

humanize-timing.name: Timing Variation (%)
humanize-timing.description: Random variation applied to each press and release.

humanize-drift.name: CPS Drift
humanize-drift.description: How far (in CPS) the spam speed slowly wanders up and down.

humanize-miss.name: Missed Click Chance (%)
humanize-miss.description: Chance that a click is skipped. Never applies in ship.

humanize-ship.name: Humanize In Ship
humanize-ship.description: Also apply humanization in ship. Makes the flight slightly less straight.
